summary: Salkantay is an early-stage fund focused on Latin American founders and startups targeting Spanish-speaking countries, with 23 portfolio companies listed on its homepage. It groups its interest into human improvement (edtech, jobtech, healthtech), economic development (fintech, proptech, SaaS) and a sustainable planet (agtech, climate tech, smart cities). The contact page hosts a form that asks for industry and round from pre-seed to Series B. Check size and a street address are not stated.
